patch_description:
This version treats each promising network as a search parent and allocates LP evaluations according to both its historical productivity and its structural diversity. Parents that produce incumbent improvements receive more attention, while under-tested and distant parents retain a guaranteed exploration chance.

For each parent, the search prioritizes degree-preserving two-switches that remove bottleneck links, using dual prices and QUBO energy as inexpensive filters. It also samples three-link rotations and occasional random switches to escape local structure. A small batch is evaluated per visit so that poor parents do not consume the budget in one burst; every valid, uncached evaluation can update a diverse elite archive. Initial repaired candidates are likewise ranked by energy while preserving structural variety.
